messages:
Ana (CS): Quick weekly pulse on caching + batching effectiveness for flagged accounts (short thread).
Ana (CS): Metrics snapshot: hit rate = 62% (+4ppt w/w), avg batch size = 3.8 reqs (was 5.2), cost per 1k tokens = $0.95 (−8%), 99th latency = 420ms (+60ms), error rate = 0.9% (flat), spend = +12% (traffic spike). :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Ethan: Which tenants drove the drop in batch size? any correlation with model fallbacks or region routing?
Ana (CS): Early morning spike — affected NovaHealth, TrueSight, BlueHarbor. Pattern: high single-request tail and an infra fallback during the window.
Ravi: Confirmed — fallback kicked in 03:12–03:40 UTC and pinned some sessions to single-shard routing which prevented batching. Log excerpt:
```
2025-10-17T03:14:22Z deploy-8321 INFO fallback=on affected_sessions=1789
```
Ravi: That caused avg batch size to drop; hit-rate later recovered as caches warmed.
Lina (AM): Customer notes: NovaHealth & BlueHarbor reported higher latency and asked if cache TTL or config changed. They were concerned about cost impact.
Ana (CS): Cache config unchanged on our side — uplift in hit rate later suggests warmup. Still need to proactively notify.
Ethan: Proposed mitigation: don't allow batching target < 4 unless 95th latency > 600ms. Could we gate the fallback so it doesn't break batching for warm sessions?
Ravi: I'll draft an RFC and a patch. Short-term mitigation: revert fallback for sessions that had >1 queued request and bump batching-window to 30ms for low-traffic agents.
Ana (CS): Action items: 1) Ravi open ticket CS-812 (infra fallback rollback + guard), 2) Ethan draft SLO/rule for batching aggressiveness, 3) Lina prepare customer note with timeline and cost impact estimate. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
deploy-bot: deploy-8321 rolled at 2025-10-17T03:14:22Z :white_check_mark:
Ethan: Can we also share a quick per-tenant cost delta? a rough calc helps renewals team.
Ana (CS): I'll pull a 24h delta and post in this thread by noon.
Lina (AM): I'll reach out to NovaHealth contact and offer a short walkthrough of caching settings.
Ravi: Will include a short blameless postmortem in ticket.
Ana (CS): Thanks team — short sync tomorrow 09:30 to confirm fixes. :thumbsup:
